title: document-draft: one editable PDF document per object
detail: New bundle `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/document-draft`: `createDocumentDraftFeature({ subjectTypes, pdf: { render, store }, retention?, access?, authorizeSubject?, unscopedRoles?, subjectScreens? })`. A draft is created from a PDF template or one of its variants (`create`: subject, `templateSlug`, `variant?`, `locale`, `variables`), changed with the structured ops of `patch-draft` (`patch`, `setVariable`/`setMeta`/`setResource` refused) or with editor HTML (`save`), finalized to a stored PDF (`finalize`, printed from the draft body with the frozen variables) and reopened with `revise`; `discard` drops an open draft. The template stays unchanged. Queries `blocks` and `by-subject`. `{ render: renderPdfBeforeTransaction, store: storeRenderedPdf }` from renderer-puppeteer-client fits `pdf` as it is. Body, variables and last change are personal data of the draft row; `forgetDocumentDraftsOfSubject(ctx, subject)` purges the drafts of an erased object and erases their keys. The editor is the dormant custom screen `document-draft:screen:document-draft-editor` (`DOCUMENT_DRAFT_EDITOR_SCREEN_ID`), mounted with `documentDraftClient()` from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/document-draft/web`: opened with the draft id, it edits the text (placeholder chips show money, date and percent values formatted as the printed PDF does; the draft stores the template title as `templateTitle` and the editor shows it instead of the slugs), lists the deviations from the template, saves, finalizes or discards (then opens `subjectScreens[subjectType]` with the subject id) and reopens a finalized draft. The bundle requires `user-data-rights`. The feature adds the `read_document_drafts` table, so apps that mount it need a schema migration.
